# Naviamp v2.4.1

Naviamp 2.4.1 is an urgent Windows performance patch. It stops the visible desktop app from
continuously consuming a full logical CPU core while otherwise idle.

Highlights:

- Restore low idle CPU usage in the visible Windows app.
- Add an automated packaged-Windows performance gate to prevent this regression from returning.
- Restore the intended Windows equalizer behavior for low-frequency bands.

## Features

No new features in this patch.

## Improvements

- Complete the missing Spanish labels used by genre and seed-track discovery.

## Bug fixes

- Use Skiko's OpenGL renderer for packaged Windows builds, avoiding a Direct3D render thread that
  continuously occupied one logical CPU core even when Naviamp had nothing to redraw. The fix and
  regression coverage are tracked in [issue #47](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/47) and
  [pull request #48](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/48).
- Restore bundled BASS FX support and shared equalizer calculations on Windows so low-frequency
  equalizer bands behave as intended.

## Upgrade notes

Existing v2.x installations can upgrade in place. This release adds no database migration and
requires no settings reset.

## Known issues

The iOS artifact remains an unsigned preview. Windows and macOS packages are not publisher-signed
and may show operating-system warnings.
